method.fresh_source_method: Every HTTP body captured through the supplied review_capture.py as quality; fresh captures, not author-cache reuse, were read. Shared Dex pacing observed >=2.1s; minimum observed global gap 2.1000277996063232 seconds.
method.frequency: No unrefreshed frequency rank is used as acceptance or rejection evidence.
method.rubric_C: Concrete familiarity cautions inform vocabulary review; incoming target floors, difficulty, salience and actual HCI targets remain separately unapproved.
method.nearest_owners: Actual main bundle and twelve protected closure packets constrain ownership; no existing metadata or input is moved.
method.source_binding_checks: Original module/pool hashes, all fresh body hashes, ordinary table sets and exact DEX/DOOM identifiers checked. Qualified syntax is disclosed as component noun/adjective authority, not fabricated full-phrase dictionary entries.

derived_evidence.scope: Fresh PDF text extractions and one fresh manufacturer figure; originals retained.
